idea-plugin.name: OneClickAPI
idea-plugin.description:
OneClickAPI - A powerful IntelliJ IDEA plugin that revolutionizes API development for Spring Boot projects.

Generate complete REST APIs with advanced data management capabilities directly from @Entity-annotated or POJO classes with just clicks. Select multiple classes at once, and generate hundreds or even thousands of APIs in seconds! New: - Preview Before Generate: every file, its package and a diff before anything is written - Safe re-generation: Skip / Replace / Merge per file, custom-code regions are kept, generation report - JUnit 5 + Mockito + MockMvc tests and IntelliJ .http request files generated with the backend - Springdoc / OpenAPI annotations and an OpenAPI 3 spec - API standards: Bean Validation, pagination/sorting/filtering/search, standard response and error format, soft delete, audit fields, API versioning, relations as ids (no circular DTOs) - Team presets in .oneclickapi.yml (Standard Spring Boot CRUD, Clean Architecture, Enterprise API, MyBatis Backend) - Project detection (Maven/Gradle, Spring Boot version, JPA/MyBatis, MapStruct, Lombok, Liquibase/Flyway) with optional dependency additions - Works with IntelliJ IDEA 2024.2 and every newer release Key Features: - Automated API generation from JPA Entity or POJO classes - Auto-creation of DTOs, Mappers, Repositories, Services & Controllers - Lombok integration: Automatic annotations and boilerplate reduction - Smart repository method generation (JPA/Custom implementations) - Clean architecture enforcement with proper package structure - File Upload APIs: Built-in PDF/Image upload endpoints generation - Liquibase integration: Automated database schema management - Enhanced Service Layer architecture for business logic isolation - Robust exception handling: Auto-generated global error controllers - **Multi-Class Selection:** Select hundreds of classes and generate thousands of APIs instantly - **MyBatis Support:** Generate APIs from simple POJO classes in addition to @Entity classes - **Liquibase Flexibility:** Generate database schemas in YAML, SQL, XML, or JSON formats - **Advanced Global Exception Handling:** Automatically handles and customizes error responses - **File Upload API Support:** Instantly generate APIs for PDF and image uploads - **Clean Code & Best Practices:** Automatically follows clean architecture principles, ensuring readable, maintainable code How It Works: 1. Install plugin and right-click any @Entity or POJO class 2. Select "Generate API" from context menu 3. Configure options (enable file upload support, etc.) 4. Get production-ready APIs in seconds! Why Choose OneClickAPI: - 80% faster API development cycle - Enterprise-grade code quality out of the box - Future-proof architecture patterns - Customizable templates for special requirements - Seamless file handling capabilities - Reduced maintenance overhead - **Highly customizable:** Ability to tweak templates and adjust generated code based on project needs - **Boosted productivity:** Simplifies complex tasks, letting developers focus on business logic instead of boilerplate code
